evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Not asked. Rep moved directly into probing for logistics.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns were raised by the customer during step 2.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Rep mentioned best value days (Mondays through Thursdays at $208/hr vs Friday at $222/hr) and offered the rate difference, but this was presented hourly, not as a total dollar saving. No flexibility question asked about switching to a cheaper day.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Never asked. No rate lock mentioned, no explicit ask for the business. Call ended with customer declining the service due to the 2.5-hour minimum not fitting their budget.

top_strength: Danah clearly explained the all-inclusive pricing model, the 2.5-hour minimum, and the 15-minute increment billing structure, giving the customer a transparent and accurate estimate range of $520–$728 for their one-bedroom move.
coaching_note: This call is missing the entire foundation: no two-concerns question to uncover what matters to the customer, no promises (On-Time Guarantee or Damage Coverage) to address their concerns, no prep framing to justify the minimum, no genuine temperature check before pricing, and no attempt to ask for the business — the customer was allowed to self-select out when a coached response might have saved the deal.
